About

About NASHA.

NASHA is food and beer designed together to draw you in, made in plain sight and shared at a long table.

It is a project of Ritesh Mamidi, who is building toward an Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas. Today it is a body of design and a plan, not a business that serves anyone.

The founder

Ritesh Mamidi is building NASHA as a one-person project, using the pre-capital period to develop as much of the company as can be done without money: product system, economic model, operating blueprint, a private website and a data room, and personal home-kitchen testing. No hospitality, culinary or brewing credentials are claimed; the capability gaps are listed openly in the future-team view.

The name

The word NASHA as it appears here is a temporary typographic wordmark, not a final logo. No NASHA logo has been designed, approved or released, and no logo exploration is published on this site.

The founder chose the name NASHA. Legal clearance of the name has not been completed, and nothing here claims trademark ownership, registration, availability, or ownership of any domain or social handle. If a professional review finds a problem, the name returns to the founder for a decision.

Nasha means intoxication or addiction in Hindi and Urdu. We chose it for the feeling of being drawn in by food, craft and company. We commit to never romanticising addiction, alcoholism or dangerous drinking, and to asking cultural advisors to review the name and our language before launch.

About these images

NASHA is currently in development. Photographic-style images on this site are concept visualizations used to communicate the intended experience. They are not photographs of an operating NASHA location, finished dishes or brewed NASHA beer.

  • Concept visualization: photographic-style images made with AI image tools by the founder and edited. People in them are synthetic and are not real individuals. A few details, such as the temporary NASHA lettering on a sign, were added by script. Equipment in them is illustrative.
  • Concept illustration: original drawings made for this project. The food and beer drawings show proposed presentation only and are not pictures of finished dishes or beers.

When real dishes are cooked and real beers are brewed, real photography will replace these pictures and each picture will say what stage it shows: concept visualization, prototype, tested product or final photography. None is above concept stage today.

Rights status: the image tools' commercial-use terms have not been verified by the project, so these images are marked provisional in the rights register for this private, unindexed prototype and must be re-checked, replaced or licensed before any public launch.

How we handle rights

Every file on this site is listed in a rights register: what it is, who made it, how, and under what licence. Fonts are Inter and Instrument Serif, both under the SIL Open Font License. We use no stock photos, no third-party scripts and no trackers.

Evidence and honesty

Design is not proof. This site shows what we have designed. It does not show that anyone wants it, that it can be brewed or cooked well, or that it can be built. Those are tests still to come, and Labs will report them. We publish no reviews, ratings, press, awards, waitlists or opening dates, because none exist.

Contact

There is no public contact address or mailing list yet. We will add one when it is real.

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development.

The name was chosen by the founder. Legal clearance of the name is pending. Nothing here claims trademark ownership. There is no brewery, restaurant or truck open, and nothing is for sale. No site has been chosen.

In Hindi and Urdu, nasha means intoxication or addiction. We chose it for the feeling of being drawn in by food, craft and company. We take that meaning seriously and will never present excess or addiction as something to admire. Cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Images show a possible future. The photographic-style pictures are concept visualizations made with AI tools and edited, and the drawings are illustrations. They are not photographs of NASHA, of its food, or of its beer. About these images.

Menu items are designs for testing, not served food. Heat and vegetarian labels describe how a dish is designed, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly. Alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.

The word NASHA in the header and in some pictures is a temporary typographic placeholder, set in a standard font. It is not a logo, not an official brand mark, and no trademark is claimed. No logo has been approved or released.
